text:
jen: Heads-up: CI regen produced a typegen change that breaks our TS sample apps. smoke tests failing fast.

omar: yikes. which API?

jen: `createCompletion` overloads changed ordering. callers that pass a single `prompt` string now hit runtime mismatches in compiled JS.

li: can you paste the minimal diff?

jen: sure: 
```diff
- export function createCompletion(prompt?: string, options?: CreateOpts): Promise<Completion>
+ export function createCompletion(options?: CreateOpts, prompt?: string): Promise<Completion>
```

omar: that will definitely break positional usage. we intentionally switched param sorting last sprint to match python generator order, but i thought we handled optional-first cases.

jen: i ran a local regen and bisected to commit `b4c3f7` in the typegen repo. the change was small but the comparator now prefers schema-declared index over original param index in edge cases.

li: immediate mitigations?

jen: pinned sample-app to `@redwood/typegen@0.12.7` in the release branch which unblocks the smoke pipeline. release-bot restarted the smoke job.

release-bot: Pipeline restarted by jen. build #4841 queued.

omar: long-term fixes: either revert the param-sorting change (patch release), or keep it and bump semver with changelog and note to SDK users (major).

li: ergonomics: most JS consumers use options object form, but we have a lot of positional call sites in examples and sample apps. reverting seems less disruptive.

omar: agreed. plan: revert the comparator, cut `typegen@0.12.8` patch, run full regen across all SDKs, and publish patch clients. also add a targeted unit test for single-positional-optional emission.

jen: + add a CI guard that detects regen diffs touching exported function signatures and fails the PR with a req to add a changelog entry and semver rationale.

li: i can implement the CI guard. idea: `yarn gen:types && git diff --name-only | grep -E "\.d\.ts$|\.ts$"` then run a small AST checker for exported signatures. If found, fail the job and output a template changelog.

omar: good. also add a post-regen smoke step that runs `yarn test:smoke` for all sample apps in CI.

devex-bot: Created issue #1430 "typegen param order regression: positional arg break" assigned to omar.

jen: i've opened a revert PR and included the unit test. requesting reviews from @omar and @li.

omar: will review now. ETA for patch publish? if tests pass today we can cut patch this afternoon.

li: FYI: documenting this in DEVEX guide: prefer option bag for public methods to avoid positional fragility. i'll add a short snippet in the SDK style guide.

jen: thanks. once patch is out we should unpin release branch and rerun the full e2e matrix.

omar: agreed. also we should update the release playbook to mention regen-diff policy so release engineers know the gating steps.

jen: logging followups: I'll file a tiny postmortem note linking the bisect, commit b4c3f7, and steps taken.

li: thanks everyone. ping me when the PR lands and I'll wire the CI guard.

omar: closing loop: revert PR -> tests -> cut patch -> publish SDKs -> unpin -> run e2e. target: today. :thumbsup:
